h1: B2 Mae Sot — Fresh, Clean Budget Rooms from the B2 Group at a Wallet-Friendly Price in Mae Sot
intro: If you're after a budget stay in Mae Sot that doesn't make you gamble on cleanliness, the name budget travellers keep coming back to is B2 Mae Sot Boutique & Budget Hotel · A property in the B2 group — a budget brand with branches all over Thailand — with clean, modern rooms, strong AC, smart TVs, free parking and free Wi-Fi · It scores a strong 8.7 from 407 real reviews on Trip.com and holds a Travellers' Choice award. Reviews most often mention fresh, clean rooms and great value; the trade-off is the Mae Pa location, a little out from the town centre. Rooms start from approx. ฿550/night

body.html: B2 Mae Sot Boutique & Budget Hotel is a budget hotel in the B2 group — a brand Thai travellers know well from its branches nationwide — set in the Mae Pa area of Mae Sot district, Tak province, close to the Thai-Myanmar border · The brand's selling point is clean, modern rooms at a budget price, kept to the same standard across every branch · Cross-border business travellers, tourists using Mae Sot as a base before heading to Umphang and the Thi Lo Su waterfall, and anyone who wants a clean, no-gamble room for a few hundred baht tend to pick it because it's good value and the brand is a known quantity.

Rooms range from Superior and Deluxe up to slightly larger Premier types · The most common praise is that rooms are fresh and spotlessly clean, with comfortable beds, strong AC and good hot water in the bathroom · Every room has a smart TV you can connect to Wi-Fi for streaming, and the bright tones keep things feeling clean · The trade-off to know going in is that this is a genuine budget hotel — rooms aren't large, facilities are just-enough, and there's no pool or gym · It's a place that stands out for cleanliness and value rather than luxury or space.
"Room was brand new and super clean, soft bed, ice-cold AC — for a few hundred baht this is hard to find in Mae Sot. Staff were lovely, parking was easy, genuinely better than the price."

Facilities are pitched right for a budget stay · There's free parking, free Wi-Fi in the public areas, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, an elevator, non-smoking floors and CCTV throughout · A favourite touch is the Wake-up Café in the common area, serving tea and coffee and doubling as a lounge and co-working space · The limits reviews mention are that the Wi-Fi signal is weak in some rooms and in-room freebies are sparse — sometimes no coffee or tissues provided, which is normal at this level · Breakfast is included on some packages only, so check when you book.

The location is in the Mae Pa area on one side of Mae Sot district · It's around 5–6 km from Mae Sot Airport, and close to the Somdej Phra Naresuan Maharat Shrine and the Hilltribe Market, both about 1 km away · The thing to factor in is that it's not in the heart of Mae Sot town — several reviews note it's a bit far from the main market and restaurants, so a car or Grab makes life easier · It suits self-drivers or anyone using Mae Sot as a base before Umphang · The blended score sits around 8.7 from 407 real reviews on Trip.com, and it holds a Travellers' Choice award on Tripadvisor.

To be honest, B2 Mae Sot is a budget hotel, not a luxury boutique despite the word 'Boutique' in the name · Rooms aren't large, facilities are just-enough, Wi-Fi is weak in some rooms, and the location is a little out from the town centre · If you expect a downtown hotel with a pool or full service, it may not be the one · But seen as a fresh, clean room with strong AC and a soft bed for a few hundred baht, from a brand that holds the same standard everywhere — it does its job well and is genuine value for budget travellers in Mae Sot.

Tips from following the reviews here: if you catch a B2 brand promo you can land rates in the low hundreds, and you can sometimes upgrade the room for a small extra charge · Ask for a higher floor or a room away from the road for more quiet · If you need Wi-Fi for work, have a mobile-data backup in mind, since some rooms get a weak signal · A car makes the most sense here as the location is away from the town market · And always compare the live price on Agoda and Booking before you book, since rates move with the season and promotions.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — B2 Mae Sot Boutique & Budget Hotel, Tak

faq.q: Where is B2 Mae Sot and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 365 M.10 Maepa, Mae Sot district, Tak province · Around 5.7 km from Mae Sot Airport, and about 1 km from the Somdej Phra Naresuan Maharat Shrine and the Hilltribe Market · The thing to factor in is that it's in the Mae Pa area, a little out from the town centre and main market, so a car or Grab is handier · It's a good base for travellers heading on to Umphang.

faq.q: How much does B2 Mae Sot cost and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿550/night for a Superior room · There's a Deluxe around ฿650, a Superior Premier around ฿750, and a Deluxe Triple for three guests around ฿900 · B2 brand promos can drop rates into the low hundreds · Prices move with the season and promotions, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is B2 Mae Sot best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for budget travellers, cross-border business visitors, and anyone using Mae Sot as a base before Umphang and the Thi Lo Su waterfall who want a fresh, clean, air-conditioned room for a few hundred baht · It suits self-drivers, since the location is away from town, and anyone who trusts the B2 brand standard.

faq.q: What are the rooms and cleanliness like at B2 Mae Sot?
faq.a: Fresh, spotlessly clean rooms with comfortable beds, strong AC and a smart TV in every room are the common praise, with bright tones that keep things feeling clean · The trade-off is that this is a genuine budget hotel — rooms aren't large, facilities are just-enough, there's no pool or gym, and in-room freebies are sparse.

faq.q: Does B2 Mae Sot have Wi-Fi and breakfast?
faq.a: There's free Wi-Fi in the public areas, though many reviews note the signal is weak in some rooms, so keep a mobile-data backup if you need to work all day · Breakfast is included on some packages only, so check when you book · There's also a common-area Wake-up Café serving tea and coffee that works as a co-working spot.

faq.q: Are the review scores for B2 Mae Sot reliable?
faq.a: B2 Mae Sot has a blended score around 8.7 from 407 real reviews on Trip.com and holds a Travellers' Choice award on Tripadvisor, putting it in the top tier of properties · Its strengths are cleanliness and value from a brand that holds the same standard across branches, making it a reliable budget pick in Mae Sot.
